contexts.text: They are rejected (as useless members).

The rejection of those within the Church.
That they would reject the good of charity more than the Divine Human... Signified, Explained.
Reject ideas of evil and falsity...

Reject, suffocate, or pervert... AC 3938:5. AC 4104:3. AC 6564. AC 7491. AC 8351:2.
The rejection of the old Church...
They are then cast back into Hell.
The rejection of actual falsities. Signified, Explained.
They reject these (spiritual things) at the first view.

Rejection. Signified, Explained. AC 5456.
Rejection and change as to the things of the exterior Natural. Signified, Explained.
Thus evils... are rejected to the sides. AC 7984:2.
That they rejected the Internal. Signified, Explained.
According to the rejection, etc. the interiors are closed.
They first knew these things, and afterwards rejected them. (The consequence.)
Rejected mercy, etc.
Falsities reject all light.

The rejection of good and truth. Defined.
